title: “A Tale of Two Movements”: Identifying and Comparing Perspectives in #BlackLivesMatter and #BlueLivesMatter Movements-related Tweets using Weakly Supervised Graph-based Structured Prediction

bias_targets.methodology: Using a weakly supervised graph-based structured prediction model to detect ideological stances (pro-BlackLivesMatter vs. pro-BlueLivesMatter) and evaluate the sentiments and moral roles assigned to political and social entities (e.g., Police, Democrats, Republicans, Government) in social media discourse.

Analyzing the specific framing, sentiments (positive/negative), and roles (actor/target) explicitly assigned to racial categories (e.g., Black Americans, White Americans) within tweets to identify and compare the underlying perspectives of opposing social movements.
